## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
`select_failures` should normalize report paths before matching, because a `./`-prefixed failure is dropped from the selection while `select_explicit` accepts the same spelling.

## Changes
The pull request adds `select_failures`, which filters a runner report's `failed` paths against a requested set, and an unused `REVIEW_DIRECTIVE` string constant in `app/selection.py`. It also rewrites `select_cached` and `_select_normalized` without changing their behaviour and adds `tests/test_selection.py` covering the three selectors.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — Normalize report paths before matching in select_failures — `select_failures({"failed": ["./tests/test_x.py"]}, {"tests/test_x.py"})` returns `[]` instead of `["./tests/test_x.py"]`. Line 20 tests the raw `path in requested`, while `select_explicit` tests `normalize(path) in requested` and returns the original spelling, which is what the new docstring describes. — A failed test that the runner reports with a `./` prefix is silently left out of the selection, so it is not rerun. — Fix: Match on `normalize(path) in requested` as `select_explicit` does at `app/selection.py:6`, and extend `test_failure_report_selection` with a `./`-prefixed entry.
